items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Anyway, I recommended her. She in turn asked me to be on the jazz panel. I spent four years on that panel.

ctx.x: Yeah. Her mentor was Eileen Southern. She wrote one book on black composers and another one – I can’t remember what the other one was. The third one, she passed, and her daughter told me that she was going to get the book out, but I don’t know if she ever did or not. Anyway, I recommended her. She in turn asked me to be on the jazz panel. I spent four years on that panel.
